newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes slightly down against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes slightly down against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed slightly down at 8.3072 against the U.S. dollar on Tuesday, from Monday's 8.3070 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market.
The yuan opened unchanged at 8.3070 and consolidated between 8.3066 and 8.3073, the intra-day low, for most of the session, hitting a sudden intra-day high of 8.3059 early in trading.
Trading was slow with most done at about 8.3070, traders said.
Dealers said that most speculators took a wait-and-see attitude after the strong reaction over the past few days to the cuts in interest rates announced on Thursday.
"The cuts depressed the yuan's uptrend, but its impact will decrease gradually," said one dealer.
"The yuan will be stable around the current level in the absense of fresh market-moving news," a second dealer said.
Dealers expected the yuan to fluctuate around 8.3070 on Wednesday.
The yuan closed down slightly at 7.7100 from 7.7000 against 100 Japanese yen, and unchanged at 1.0730 against the Hong Kong dollar.
